paper_title: Narrative Media Framing in Political Discourse
caption: Distribution of FOCUS values across political leanings
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the distribution of FOCUS values across different political leanings. The horizontal axis represents political leanings, listed in order from left to right as ‘Left bias,’ ‘Left center bias,’ ‘Quest. source,’ ‘Right bias,’ and ‘Right center bias.’ The vertical axis, labeled “FOCUS value,” is a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick intervals of 0.1. The tallest bar, colored blue, represents “VICTIM” with a FOCUS value of 0.8, while the shortest bar, colored red, representing “VICTIM bias,” has a FOCUS value of 0.6. A second bar, colored orange, representing “HERO” has a FOCUS value of 0.7, and a third bar, colored brown, representing "VILLAIN” has a FOCUS value of 0.4. A fourth bar, colored gray, showing “VILLAIN bias” has a FOCUS value of 0.3. All bars are presented without any visual emphasis, and the bars are not sorted in any particular order.
